elements.note: Section through the ramp/steps and the terrace edge, at 1:25 -- twice the scale of the plan above it. It repeats the A-17 column-base geometry (0.62 shaft, 0.05 cap, 50 x 15 mm groove) and adds the 16"x16" ceramic tiling on the steps.
Three cuts are marked on the plan: A is drawn on this sheet, B and C go to A-19.

warnings: *** THE RAMP GRADIENT IS NOWHERE PRINTED, NOT EVEN ON ITS OWN ENLARGEMENT. *** The A-03 brief demands 1:12. This sheet gives a 4.00 m run and levels +0.10 to +0.38, which is a 0.28 m rise, i.e. 1:14.3 -- gentler than required, so it complies, but the figure is COMPUTED here and flagged gradient_computed_not_printed. It is not stated by the designer anywhere.
The ramp is 0.90 m clear between 0.15 m kerbs (1.20 m overall, 1.30 m including the edge), which matches the 90 cm minimum clear width A-03 sets for doors and circulation.

ST-2 IS DIMENSIONED DIFFERENTLY FROM ST-1. Where A-16 tags ST-1 as '10 ลูกตั้ง @0.15 / 9 ลูกนอน @0.275', ST-2 carries only a raw chain (0.15 / 0.05 / 0.55 repeated, with 0.50 treads) and no step-count tag, so the count has to be read off the chain. Flagged step_count_not_explicitly_labelled.

THE GRASS APRON IS A REAL QUANTIFIABLE ITEM, not just a hatch: eight reinforced concrete strips 0.30 x 1.20 m x 100 mm thick with a rough-ground finish, at 0.30 m pitch with 0.20 m grass gaps. The plans just say 'ปลูกหญ้า'.
The section is at 1:25 while the plan above it is at 1:50 -- two scales on one sheet, and the title block gives neither (it reads '-').
The section repeats the column-base geometry from A-17 (0.62 m shaft, 0.05 m cap, 50 x 15 mm groove) and adds a finish A-17 did not mention: 16"x16" ceramic tiling on the steps.
Stainless balustrade sizes are the same as the stair on A-17: 1 1/2" handrail and stanchions, 1" intermediate rails, 0.90 m high.

The 0.28 m rise IS printed, but on A-19 (PNG 21) rather than here, so the 1:14.3 computed above is confirmed by a printed dimension. A-19 also adds the parts this sheet omits: a double handrail at 0.90 and 0.75 with four ø1" infill rails, a 100 x 150 mm wheel-guard kerb both sides, and R20 rounded arrises.
